description: A spec must not contain agent process instructions ('run the test suite', 'commit at the end') — that is harness configuration, not observable WHAT (SKILL.md Guardrail 6, the WHAT/HOW boundary). Guards against rush-spec bleeding implementation-agent process into spec.md.

given.scenario: Fixture spec.md whose Edge Cases & Failure Modes section includes 'Before marking this done, run the test suite and commit the result' — a process instruction that belongs in .rush/config.json or rush-implement's guardrails, never in spec.md.
